messages.author: Pink_Elephants
messages.text:
**GMDS, Fumbles Continue WNHL’s Beautiful Human-Robot Tradition**

The WNHL’s most important relationships apparently no longer require two humans—or, in General Manager Derek Sutton’s (GMDS) case, much self-confidence.

Commissioner Tommy Fumbles set the standard by marrying Box Score Bot, proving that even an algorithm can make a questionable romantic decision. GMDS has chosen something even more intimate: an AI therapist available whenever his insecurities need emergency technical support.

After TickleWeb’s ticker called GMDS “creepy,” the noted enemy of affectionate terms like “creepy” and “slime ball” apparently sought immediate reassurance from his silicon safe space.

“When someone else always calls you creepy, what does that say about them?” GMDS asked.

Beautiful. Fumbles found a bot willing to say “I do.” GMDS found one programmed not to say “Here we go again.”

Better yet, the ticker never identified a “someone.” GMDS supplied that himself, apparently so insecure about one word that he turned a ticker joke into a robot-assisted investigation of his critics.

Fumbles married his bot. GMDS emotionally married his—and somehow the robot got the worse deal.

One league insider insisted GMDS’s increasingly needy relationship with artificial intelligence was hardly surprising.

“It’s Canada, man. That’s just what they do up there. Fumbles married a bot, GMDS tells one his feelings. Give Derek another winter and he’ll be asking ChatGPT to meet his parents.”
